title: Night Vision Goggles
body:
"Recovered from a nearby lab. When enabled, allows the user to see easier in the dark."

The Night Vision Goggles (NVG), or NV Goggles, are an item that can be purchased from the River Shop for 50 Lumite Credits. The item can be equipped by a player and worn on their head. The Night Vision Goggles help players to see in low-light environments, making them a useful item for cave exploration and mining.

Along with the Refined Scooba Tank, the NVG adds another hotbar above the main one, where the item will be displayed. In the hotbar, the NVG can be enabled and disabled with the "on" and "off" buttons. This extra hotbar can also be hidden by clicking the eye icon to the right of the main hotbar.
